title: Naruto: Shippuuden
synopsis:
It has been two and a half years since Naruto Uzumaki left Konohagakure, the Hidden Leaf Village, for intense training following events which fueled his desire to be stronger. Now Akatsuki, the mysterious organization of elite rogue ninja, is closing in on their grand plan which may threaten the safety of the entire shinobi world.
 
Although Naruto is older and sinister events loom on the horizon, he has changed little in personality—still rambunctious and childish—though he is now far more confident and possesses an even greater determination to protect his friends and home. Come whatever may, Naruto will carry on with the fight for what is important to him, even at the expense of his own body, in the continuation of the saga about the boy who wishes to become Hokage.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Homecoming
episodes_data.description: A figure passes through the gates. It’s an older Naruto, who has returned from a long training journey with Jiraiya. Naruto Uzumaki is back!

episodes_data.title: Akatsuki Begins Their Move
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Sakura team up and challenge Kakashi to a survival challenge to show off their progress.

episodes_data.title: The results of training
episodes_data.description: Naruto’s and Sakura’s combined skills force Kakashi to use his Sharingan right off the bat. Naruto masterfully unleashes his jutsu one after another.

episodes_data.title: Jinchuuriki of the Sand
episodes_data.description: Gaara is quick to detect Deidara’s presence, and an aerial battle ensues with Deidara on his giant bird and Gaara atop sand.

episodes_data.title: As the Kazekage...!
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Sakura defeat Kakashi in the survival challenge. Tsunade assigns them to a three-man squad led by Kakashi, who tells them they are now his equals.

episodes_data.title: Quota Clear!
episodes_data.description: In order to protect his village from Deidara’s explosive clay, Gaara uses his chakra to create a giant sand shield.

episodes_data.title: Sprinting Kankurou
episodes_data.description: Gaara, his strength completely exhausted, is whisked away by Deidara. Kankuro ignores Baki’s efforts to stop him and immediately sets out in pursuit with a platoon to rescue Gaara.

episodes_data.title: Excursion, Kakashi's Group
episodes_data.description: On her way to the Sand Village, Temari encounters Kakashi and his team. Kakashi admonishes Naruto when he tries to rush ahead…

episodes_data.title: Jinchuuriki Tears
episodes_data.description: An urgent message from the Sand Village detailing the Akatsuki’s kidnapping of the Kazekage reaches the Hidden Leaf Village. Tsunade wastes no time in ordering Team Kakashi to the Sand Village.

episodes_data.title: Sealing Technique - Complete Nine Mystical Dragon Seal
episodes_data.description: The Sand ninja fight against time to treat Kankuro. Even the Sand’s poison expert, Granny Chiyo, is baffled. The only hope lies with the reinforcements sent by Tsunade.

episodes_data.title: Apprentice of the Medical Ninja
episodes_data.description: Sakura treats a critically ill Kankuro. After extensive training she’s now a full-fledged Medic Ninja, and Sakura amazes everyone with her sure, steady hands.

episodes_data.title: The Retired Old Woman's Determination
episodes_data.description: Pakkun finds the hideout of the Akatsuki. Team Kakashi and Temari prepare to set out to get Gaara back, but Temari is ordered to stay behind and help guard the village.

episodes_data.title: Destined Meeting
episodes_data.description: Team Kakashi encounter Itachi Uchiha, who had dealt them a bitter defeat in the past. Kakashi warns everyone not to look into Itachi’s Sharingan Eyes.

episodes_data.title: Naruto's Growth
episodes_data.description: Guy prepares to use a forbidden secret jutsu. Meanwhile, Naruto falls under Itachi’s genjutsu, and all the anti-genjutsu training he underwent with Jiraiya races through Naruto’s mind.

episodes_data.title: Hidden sphere, It's name is...
episodes_data.description: Granny Chiyo and Sakura  rescue Naruto from Itachi’s genjutsu. Without a moment’s delay, Kakashi begins a counterattack.

episodes_data.title: The Secret Behind Jinchuuriki
episodes_data.description: Chiyo and Kakashi realize that the attack was just a diversion, and that the Akatsuki have already begun the process of extracting the Tailed Beast from Gaara. Granny Chiyo explains to Naruto and Sakura the connection between the Tailed Beast and the Jinchûriki...

episodes_data.title: Gaara dies!
episodes_data.description: Teams Kakashi and Guy take a short rest. Granny Chiyo watches Naruto dozing off and is reminded of Sasori as a child. The pursuit resumes, and when Chiyo wonders why Naruto puts such effort into rescuing Gaara…

episodes_data.title: Break in! Button Hook Entry
episodes_data.description: Teams Kakashi and Guy reach the Akatsuki hideout. They hurry to infiltrate but are thwarted by a five-seal barrier. The only way to break the barrier is to remove all five seals at once.

episodes_data.title: Trap Operation! Team Gai's Enemy
episodes_data.description: Breaking the five-seal barrier set off a trap, which now has Team Guy battling amazingly accurate copies of themselves. Back at the Akatsuki hideout, Deidara and Sasori struggle to take the Nine-Tail Jinchûriki.

episodes_data.title: Hiruko vs Two Female Ninja
episodes_data.description: At last, the showdown between the old woman and her grandson begins. Sakura is confused by Sasori’s strange appearance, and Granny Chiyo explains that this is Hiruko…

episodes_data.title: True Face of Sasori
episodes_data.description: Granny Chiyo and Sakura manage to expose Sasori, who amazingly looks no older than he did twenty years earlier. Chiyo is even more shocked at the second puppet that Sasori produces.

episodes_data.title: Chiyo's Inner Hand
episodes_data.description: Sakura is caught by Sasori’s tactic and surrounded by a poison cloud. But she uses a Paper Bomb to blow herself free from the poisonous fumes.

episodes_data.title: "Father" and "Mother"
episodes_data.description: Chiyo and Sakura take cover, and Sasori wastes no time unleashing a ruthless attack. Chiyo fights back to protect Sakura, but in an instant the Father and Mother puppets are sealed by the Iron Sand.

episodes_data.title: The Third Kazekage
episodes_data.description: Sakura counters the Iron Sand attack of the Third Kazekage puppet with superhuman strength. She learned from Tsunade that the most important skill of a Medic Ninja is the ability to evade an attack.

episodes_data.title: Between Life and Death in Three Minutes
episodes_data.description: Sakura destroys the Third Kazekage puppet thanks to a secret antidote she had taken. Sakuro explains to a surprised Granny Chiyo that this antidote converts the poison into harmless protein and is effective for about three minutes.

episodes_data.title: 10 Puppets VS 100 Puppets
episodes_data.description: Sakura and Granny Chiyo are engaged in a fierce battle with Sasori, who is able turn himself into a human puppet. They somehow bring Sasori down within the time limit, but he ends up reviving.

episodes_data.title: The Dream that Couldn't Come True
episodes_data.description: Although stung with poison herself, Granny Chiyo uses the last of the antidote on Sakura. Mocking the tender scene between Granny Chiyo and Sakura, Sasori attempts to end Granny Chiyo`s life.

episodes_data.title: The Resurrected Beasts
episodes_data.description: Team Guy senses the result of the Sakura and Granny Chiyo’s desperate struggle while still in battle with his deadly copy. Although Guy’s team members are showing fatigue, their copies remain strong!

episodes_data.title: Kakashi Open Eyes!
episodes_data.description: Sakura hurries to get to Naruto with Granny Chiyo, who is suffering from the poison. The members of Team Guy rush to assist Team Kakashi.

episodes_data.title: Esthetics of a Moment
episodes_data.description: Naruto loses all reason to anger and is gradually taken over by the Nine-Tailed Fox Spirit. Having been forewarned by Jiraiya, Kakashi narrowly manages to suppress the Nine-Tailed Fox.

episodes_data.title: Thing to be Inherited
episodes_data.description: Relying on Naruto`s power, Granny Chiyo performs the Transmigration Jutsu on Gaara. Sakura is saddened when she realizes the cost of this jutsu.

episodes_data.title: The Return of Kazekage
episodes_data.description: Gaara and his rescuers make a triumphant return to the Hidden Sand Village. After paying their respects at Granny Chiyo`s grave, Naruto and the Leaf ninja reluctantly take their leave.

episodes_data.title: A New Target
episodes_data.description: Everyone has returned to the Hidden Leaf Village. Kakashi is hospitalized for a week due to the strain caused by his Mangekyo Sharingan.

episodes_data.title: The New Team Kakashi is Formed!
episodes_data.description: After attacking Naruto, Sai predicts that they will meet again soon, then vanishes. Tsunade meets with the village elders, Homura and Koharu…

episodes_data.title: An unnecessary action
episodes_data.description: Naruto is enraged when he discovers that Sai attacked him in order to test his strength. Sakura pulls them apart, but tensions are running high between the members of Team Kakashi.

episodes_data.title: Feigned smile
episodes_data.description: The new Team Kakashi heads for Tenchikyo. To Naruto, Sai is just temporarily filling in for Sasuke. When Sai shows his contempt for Sasuke, the antagonism comes to a head.

episodes_data.title: Untitled
episodes_data.description: Sakura comes across Sai working on an abstract painting. He tells her that he`s unable to give it a title. Bothered by his manner, Sakura finds an unusual picture book among Sai`s things.

episodes_data.title: Simulation
episodes_data.description: In preparation for Tenchikyo, Yamato conducts a half-day simulation in order to get a grasp on the fighting skills and jutsu of Team Kakashi. Sai abandons Naruto to conclude the simulated mission successfully.

episodes_data.title: The Heaven and Earth Bridge
episodes_data.description: The day for capturing the spy is finally here. Just as planned, Yamato takes on Sasori`s likeness and waits until the Akatsuki spy appears. The spy turns out to be none other than Kabuto.

episodes_data.title: Kyuubi Unleashed
episodes_data.description: Faced with Orochimaru, his sworn enemy, Naruto suddenly releases the power of his Nine-Tailed Fox. When Yamato sees Naruto`s fourth tail appear, he recalls Jiraiya`s tale of how he nearly lost his life to the transformed Naruto.

episodes_data.title: Top-Secret Mission Start
episodes_data.description: When his third tail appears, all that Naruto can see is Orochimaru. He is blind even to his teammates.

episodes_data.title: Orochimaru VS Jinchuuriki
episodes_data.description: With the release of his fourth tail, Naruto completely loses his awareness and is overtaken by destructive impulses.

episodes_data.title: Sakura's Tears
episodes_data.description: Although he has changed almost completely into his animal form and has lost all awareness, Naruto refuses to give up the idea of bringing Sasuke home.

episodes_data.title: Facts of the Fight
episodes_data.description: Taking advantage of the confusion, Sai makes contact with Orochimaru. After reviewing the contents of the documents given to him, Orochimaru decides to take Sai back to the hideout.

episodes_data.title: The Result of the Betrayal
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Sakura are shocked when they hear that Danzo`s goal is to work with Orochimaru to once again attempt to defeat the Leaf Village.

episodes_data.title: The Unfinished Page
episodes_data.description: Naruto is shocked to learn that he was the one responsible for the destruction around them and for Sakura`s injuries.

episodes_data.title: Sneak In! Den of the Poisonous Snake
episodes_data.description: Sai shudders when he finally meets Sasuke face to face in Orochimaru`s hideout. The list that Sai gave to Orochimaru lists the members of the Anbu Black Ops, the corps under the direct control of the Hokage.

episodes_data.title: Bonds
episodes_data.description: Team Kakashi is able to find Sai with Yamato guiding them. They immediately begin questioning Sai about Danzo`s plans for destroying the Leaf Village, and surprisingly, Sai divulges everything.

episodes_data.title: Important Person
episodes_data.description: Kabuto carries out a surprise attack on Team Kakashi to take back Sai, but a change has come over Sai since Sakura pointed out his contradictions.

episodes_data.title: The Sketch Book Tells a Story
episodes_data.description: Naruto, while nursing his injuries caused by the release of the Nine-Tailed Fox, searches frantically for Sasuke. Seeing this, Sai recalls the feelings he once had for his older brother and finally manages to complete his unfinished picture.

episodes_data.title: Reunion
episodes_data.description: Team Kakashi are stunned to learn that Sai`s true mission is to kill Sasuke.  Naruto wants to believe that the smile Sai showed them was real, but there is a possibility that it was all an act.

episodes_data.title: Strength of Uchiha
episodes_data.description: Team Kakashi finally have their wish to be reunited with Sasuke granted. Although it has been three long years, Sasuke`s feelings have not changed. His ultimate goal is to get revenge against his older brother, Itachi.

episodes_data.title: Title
episodes_data.description: Sasuke`s desire for revenge remains firm, no matter how hard Naruto tries to talk him out of it. Yamato tries to take Sasuke by force, but interference by Orochimaru brings things to a quick close.

episodes_data.title: Nightmare
episodes_data.description: Naruto has a strange nightmare several days after their failure to bring Sasuke home. Even after he awakens wisps of the dream keep haunting him.

episodes_data.title: Wind
episodes_data.description: Naruto begins to train with Kakashi. Kakashi finds it exhausting working with Naruto, who can’t understand anything explained to him.

episodes_data.title: Squirm
episodes_data.description: Learning that his chakra is of the "wind" type that is outstanding for fighting, Naruto puts more effort into his training.

episodes_data.title: Deprived of Eternal Sleep
episodes_data.description: Team Kakashi is ordered to resolve the frequent vandalizing of graves at the Fire Temple. When it becomes clear that the vandals aren’t after the possessions buried with the dead, Yamato suspects that they want the corpses of the ninja buried in the four hidden tombs near Fire Temple.

episodes_data.title: Loneliness
episodes_data.description: At the Fire Temple, Chiriku explains to Team Kakashi that the hidden tombs hold the guards of the Land of Fire’s feudal lord. At one time Chiriku and Asuma were members of that organization.

episodes_data.title: New Enemy
episodes_data.description: Word comes that the last of the hidden graves has been broken into. Naruto and the others go after the coffin, but it turns out to be a trap.

episodes_data.title: Mutability
episodes_data.description: Team Kakashi is split up by the enemy`s Earth Summoning Jutsu. They are forced to fight the attacking assassins, but the enemy has the advantage since they know the lay of the land.

episodes_data.title: Contact
episodes_data.description: Sora confronts Furido, the mysterious figure who has broken into the hidden graves. Impressed by Sora’s unusual strength, he admonishes him, “You should reevaluate how you use that power Heaven has blessed you with,” and disappears, leaving him with a cryptic message that he is an old friend of his father.

episodes_data.title: Teammate
episodes_data.description: Yamato believes that the assailants were not grave robbers but were after Sora. He decides to appoint Sora to Team Kakashi as a temporary stand-in for the injured Sai.

episodes_data.title: Two Kings
episodes_data.description: By chance, Naruto and Sora get Asuma to coach them. Under the guidance of Asuma’s iron fist, they immerse themselves in training with Wind Chakra.

episodes_data.title: Jet-Black Signal Fire
episodes_data.description: Tsunade catches Danzo in a secret meeting with a ninja from the Hidden Rain Village. But the ninja turns out to be a spy for the Hidden Leaf.

episodes_data.title: Lockdown of Darkness
episodes_data.description: Under cover of a giant power outage, Furido begins his assault on the Hidden Leaf. The village immediately goes on alert, but Furido’s men put up a barrier, and everyone in the village is trapped inside.

episodes_data.title: Revived Souls
episodes_data.description: In order to stop the impending disaster, Asuma rushes toward the electric generator system. There he sees the Guardian Shinobi Twelve who have come to life once more through Revival Jutsu after their graves were robbed.

episodes_data.title: Multiple Death Matches
episodes_data.description: Sora is speechless when he discovers that Furido not only intends to assassinate the Hokage but plans to totally annihilate Hidden Leaf Village.

episodes_data.title: Time of Awakening
episodes_data.description: Throughout the village, Kitane’s fellow Guardian Shinobi with the Lightning Jutsu set up Limelight.

episodes_data.title: Despair
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Asuma catch up to Sora, only to find him shrouded in ominous chakra and undergoing a change.

episodes_data.title: Resonance
episodes_data.description: Furido’s true form belongs to Kazuma, one of the Guardian Shinobi Twelve who had planned the coup d’état. Asuma puts his honor on the line and goes back ten years to battle Furido once more.

episodes_data.title: Friends
episodes_data.description: Naruto desperately tries to suppress Nine Tails’ chakra and get through to Sora’s heart and soul. Naruto’s comrades are helpless against Sora’s powerful chakra and can only stand by and watch.

episodes_data.title: A Creeping Threat
episodes_data.description: Work continues in Hidden Leaf Village to erase the scars of battle. As he watches Konohamaru and the others helping with the reconstruction, Iruka sees how his students have matured.

episodes_data.title: Invasion of Akatsuki
episodes_data.description: With Kakashi’s return, Naruto resumes training for his new jutsu. Kakashi explains that the transformation training will enter the next stage.

episodes_data.title: Under the Starry Sky
episodes_data.description: The lone surviving priest is carried into Hidden Leaf Village where he reports the destruction of the Fire Temple.

episodes_data.title: The Old Monk's Prayer
episodes_data.description: In order to capture the Akatsuki, the Hidden Leaf cast a net that even an ant could not crawl through. Still, the Akatsuki elude them and frustrate Tsunade to no end.

episodes_data.title: The Next Step
episodes_data.description: Naruto is learning the elements of Wind Style Jutsu, and Kakashi lectures him on the difficulties of developing a new jutsu.

episodes_data.title: The Climbing Silver
episodes_data.description: Asuma and his team finally confront Hidan, and a battle ensues. They fight with all their strength but are shocked at Hidan’s power.

episodes_data.title: Given Judgment
episodes_data.description: Hidan releases a baffling jutsu, and Asuma bears the brunt of the attack. The jutsu is a special trick which links Hidan with Asuma’s body.

episodes_data.title: Unfulfilled Scream
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru unravels the secret of Hidan’s jutsu just in time, and Asuma attacks with all his being.

episodes_data.title: Last Words
episodes_data.description: Asuma is mortally wounded by Hidan’s jutsu, and the Akatsuki have the rest of the Hidden Leaf in a bind.

episodes_data.title: The Sad News
episodes_data.description: In a faraway land, the Akatsuki reveal their true aim of world conquest. And back at Hidden Leaf Village, Shikamaru gives his report of the mission to Tsunade.

episodes_data.title: Team 10
episodes_data.description: Asuma’s funeral is held in Hidden Leaf Village amid deep sadness. Shikamaru is the lone absentee, unable to get over the loss.

episodes_data.title: Target: Lock On
episodes_data.description: Kakashi and Team 10 set out to stop the Akatsuki. Tsunade considers Naruto’s Team 7 to be the ideal back-up for Team 10 and orders Naruto to perfect his new jutsu within 24 hours.

episodes_data.title: Kakuzu's Abilities
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru and Choji deliver the first blows in the battle, but they are thwarted by Kakuzu’s power. Kakashi counters Kakuzu’s trick and brings him down.

episodes_data.title: The Terrifying Secret
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru and his comrades desperately counter the Fire Jutsu offensive. But continuously using his Rasengan and Lightning Blade takes its toll on Kakashi.

episodes_data.title: Shikamaru's Genius
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru battles Hidan alone, deep in the forest, and after depleting his chakra, sustains a deep wound. Hidan draws his blood as he lies near death.

episodes_data.title: When You Curse Someone, You Dig Your Own Grave
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Team Kakashi arrive just in time to assist Team Asuma. Sakura and Sai are ordered by Kakashi to aid Shikamaru, who is battling alone.

episodes_data.title: Wind Release: Spiraling Shuriken
episodes_data.description: Ino and Choji are amazed at Naruto’s new jutsu, and Kakuzu senses the danger that it poses. But when released, the new jutsu dissipates before it reaches Kakuzu.

episodes_data.title: Compensation for Power
episodes_data.description: Naruto’s uses his new jutsu to bring Kakuzu down. Tsunade welcomes the teams back home and orders Team Asuma and Team Yamato to take a break.

episodes_data.title: Shinobi's Decision
episodes_data.description: Just when peace has finally settled over the village word comes that Orochimaru’s hideout has been found. Tsunade orders Kakashi, Hinato, Shino, and Kiba on a search mission to find the hideout.

episodes_data.title: Discovery - Orochimaru's Hideout
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Jiraiya arrive at the hot springs resort. As an alternative to the Wind Style: Rasen Shuriken, Jiraiya suggests to Naruto the collaboration ninjutsu with a ninja toad.

episodes_data.title: Encounter
episodes_data.description: Inside Orochimaru’s hideout Guren witnesses Sasuke defeating a thousand opponents. Meanwhile, Kabuto and Yukimaru conduct their experiment to summon the Three-Tailed Beast.

episodes_data.title: Communicating Hearts
episodes_data.description: Believing Naruto’s new jutsu is almost completed, Jiraiya heads off to investigate new information on the Akatsuki’s movements. His arm now healed, Naruto returns to the village to continue his training.

episodes_data.title: Raining All Night
episodes_data.description: Staying behind at the hideout, Rinji and Gozu become aware of a shinobi following their tracks. At the same time, Kakashi and his team notice that the enemy is using a bat for surveillance.

episodes_data.title: The Two Amulets
episodes_data.description: At the Leaf Village Naruto is busy training with Gamakichi and Gamatatsu. But when he learns that Kakashi and the others are out on a mission to locate Orochimaru’s hideout, Naruto rushes to ask Tsunade if he can join the mission.

episodes_data.title: The Unseeing Enemy
episodes_data.description: Team Yamato heads out to provide backup for Team Kakashi. Right before his departure Naruto gets a hint to perfect his new jutsu by entering Gamatatsu’s belly.

episodes_data.title: Labyrinth of Reflections
episodes_data.description: From the results of the analysis of the crystallized Parasitic insects, the enemies currently fighting Kakashi’s team are identified as users of  the Crystal Style, a rare type of jutsu. Still unclear on what Orochimaru’s objective is, Tsunade cannot hide her irritation and anxiety.

episodes_data.title: The Target Appears
episodes_data.description: Shattering the force field with his newly mastered collaboration jutsu with the toads, Naruto and the reinforcement unit arrive at the battle site. But Naruto’s new jutsu is repulsed by Guren’s ability to crystallize fluids.

episodes_data.title: Raging Tailed Beast
episodes_data.description: The Leaf ninja use The Bat to pursue Guren. Akamaru and Kiba detect a high level of chakra present at their destination. Convinced something abnormal is about to happen, Kakashi sends Naruto to the lake right before entering battle with the enemy.

episodes_data.title: Inside Mist
episodes_data.description: Inside the heavy mist, the Leaf ninja manage to rendezvous with Naruto. The team tightens their guard when they learn that the mist surrounding the lake causes illusions. The team discovers that the enemy is after the Three-Tailed Beast, and faced with this unexpected development, Kakashi decides to ask for Tsunade’s guidance.

episodes_data.title: Everyone's Feelings
episodes_data.description: Naruto enters the mist to seek out Yukimaru. Guren stays alert to protect Yukimaru, whose current situation prevents him from moving. When both sides meet, their emotion over Yukimaru sparks.

episodes_data.title: Reorganization!
episodes_data.description: Reinforcements arrive from Leaf Village. The new mission from Tsunade: seal the Three-Tailed Beast so it won’t fall into anyone else’s hands and take Yukimaru whose powers are tied to the Tailed Beast into custody.

episodes_data.title: The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier
episodes_data.description: The Leaf ninja wish to seal the Three-Tailed Beast, and Guren’s team wishes to stop them at any cost. Shizune’s sealing team begins their search as they activate the The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier to trap the Three-Tailed Beast…

episodes_data.title: Crystal Style Shattered
episodes_data.description: To protect the The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier necessary to seal the Three-Tailed Beast, Kakashi and Naruto wage their deadly battle against Guren. Sai fights a one-on-one battle with Gozu…

episodes_data.title: Barrier Battle
episodes_data.description: Kabuto plans on breaking the Leaf’s The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier from the inside by using Yukimaru’s power and have the Three-Tailed Beast go on a rampage.

episodes_data.title: Red Camellias
episodes_data.description: To protect Guren from the raging Three Tails, Yuukimaru exerts powers beyond his limits. Moved by his action, Guren now comes to regret her past sin of killing Yuukimaru’s mother.

episodes_data.title: Bitter Enemies Together
episodes_data.description: To protect Yuukimaru, Naruto and Guren fight alongside each other against the Three-Tailed beast and are swallowed. Inside the beast is an unnatural world filled with limestone.

episodes_data.title: Camellia Guidepost
episodes_data.description: The Leaf ninja learn that Naruto is inside the Three-Tailed beast. With no other alternative but to trust Yuukimaru’s mystical senses, Kakashi and the others follow the boy’s guidance and attempt a rescue mission...

episodes_data.title: Cursed Seal Counterattack
episodes_data.description: With the Three-Tailed Beast readily approaching, the Barrier Sealing team is point to make sure it doesn`t surface.  However, Kabuto - unwilling to fail Orochimaru - is out to recapture Yuukimaru at whatever the cost...

episodes_data.title: Memories of Sin
episodes_data.description: Kabuto plots to have Three Tails crush the Leaf ninja by sacrificing Yuukimaru’s power and life. Controlled by Yuukimaru, Three Tails’ awesome power is about to break free from the seal, when an unexpected ally saves Shizune’s sealing team.

episodes_data.title: The Broken Promise
episodes_data.description: Kabuto finally appears before Naruto. Learning that Orochimaru used Guren’s and Yuukimaru’s feelings for his own purposes, an enraged Naruto enters battle against Kabuto.

episodes_data.title: The Place to Return To
episodes_data.description: The Leaf ninja fall back and tend to their wounds. The battle has left everyone with serious injuries. Shizune examines Yuukimaru, who is in a coma, but his body is no longer able to control Three Tails.

episodes_data.title: The Great Snake's Pupil
episodes_data.description: Orochimaru agonizes in pain at his hideout, now requiring level-ten medications just to sustain his body. Even with excruciating pain Orochimaru is preparing for his transference ritual, and Kabuto can feel Orochimaru’s further potential. Meanwhile Sasuke also senses the time is coming when he will have to face his mentor...

episodes_data.title: The Eye of a Hawk
episodes_data.description: Orochimaru sheds his old body and transforms into a white serpent. As he attacks Sasuke to obtain his body, Orochimaru remembers the time he found the cast off skin of a white snake in front of his parents’ grave. Driven by his desire for the Sharingan, Orochimaru finally robs Sasuke of his freedom...

episodes_data.title: Zabuza's Sword
episodes_data.description: Sasuke has defeated Orochimaru. He then frees Suigetsu, a man trapped inside a water tank, and tells the man to join him. But Suigetsu does not immediately take up Sasuke’s offer…

episodes_data.title: Keeper of the Iron Prison
episodes_data.description: Sasuke and Suigetsu visit the southern hideout to recruit their next member, Karin. Suigetsu is surprised at the hideout’s low security level but is told that no prisoners can escape thanks to Karin’s abilities. What is Karin’s power that allows her to maintain order and an iron defense?

episodes_data.title: Juugo's North Hideout
episodes_data.description: Sasuke and his team head for the northern hideout to recruit their next member, Jugo. On the way, Karin explains that the northern hideout is a site for conducting horrific human experiments. A ninja with abnormal homicidal impulses, Jugo is the sole carrier of the enzyme necessary to create Orochimaru’s curse mark...

episodes_data.title: Formation!
episodes_data.description: Slipping past the riot, Sasuke arrives at Jugo’s cell. But Jugo refuses to be released, even going as far as to say he rather die a lonely death than to leave the hideout.

episodes_data.title: Kakashi's Gaiden - The Battlefield of a Boy's Life!
episodes_data.description: "More than ten years ago, the rule of the Five Great Shinobi Nations was destabilized, throwing the world into a conflict later to be known as the Third Great Ninja War. The future Fourth Hokage Minato Namikaze assigns young Kakashi, Obito of the Uchiha clan, and Rin, a medical ninja, on a mission to Kannabi Bridge..."

episodes_data.title: Kakashi's Gaiden - The Battlefield of a Boy's Life!
episodes_data.description: Obito ignores Kakashi’s order to continue with the mission and leaves to save Rin, who was kidnapped by the Rock ninja. But the enemies detect Obito’s arrival and defeat him. Kakashi arrives at the last minute and saves Obito…

episodes_data.title: Assemble
episodes_data.description: After hunting down the Four Tails, Itachi and Kisame are summoned by the leader of the Akatsuki. The leader announces the death of Orochimaru to the gathered members and the possibility of his killer, Sasuke, setting his sights on the Akatsuki organization....

episodes_data.title: The Hunt
episodes_data.description: Under Kakashi’s command, the Leaf ninja set off to find Itachi. Using Kakashi’s ninja hounds, they gather as much information as they can on Itachi. Meanwhile, the members of the Hebi also scatter to look for information on Itachi. Led by the ninja hound tracking Sasuke’s scent, Sakura arrives in town and draws near to Karin.

episodes_data.title: Clash!
episodes_data.description: Upon encountering one another, Sasuke and Deidara engage in battle. After exchanging a few blows to test Sasuke’s strength, Deidara conjures up his specialty clay dragon and wages long-range attacks against Sasuke from high above. With Tobi’s backup support, the battle seems to be going to Deidara.

episodes_data.title: Art
episodes_data.description: Determined to destroy the Sharingan to rid himself of the taste of defeat he received from Itachi, Deidara unleashes his biggest attack, the C4 Karura. Created to kill Itachi, this fierce weapon is capable of destroying living beings from the inside using millions of nano-sized bombs. Can Sasuke escape this attack fueled by Deidara’s determination to destroy the Sharingan?

episodes_data.title: Disappearance
episodes_data.description: Sasuke goes missing after being caught by Deidara’s suicidal bombing. Sensing his disappearance, Jugo, Karin, and Suigetsu race to Sasuke’s last location, where the three Hebi members discover...?

episodes_data.title: Twilight
episodes_data.description: Leaf ninja, she notifies the others and the Hebi members quickly leave the inn. To allow Sasuke to focus on his coming battle with Itachi, Karin comes up with a plan to keep the Leaf ninja occupied.

episodes_data.title: Tale of a Gutsy Ninja - The Jiraiya Ninja Chronicles
episodes_data.description: During the reign of the Second Hokage, the young Jiraiya, Orochimaru, and Tsunade are assigned to Hiruzen Sarutobi’s platoon as Genins. Fascinated by Sarutobi’s summoning jutsu, Jiraiya immerses himself in mastering the transportation technique. While training, Jiraiya accidentally transports himself to Mount Myoboku, opening the path to fulfill his destiny.

episodes_data.title: Tale of a Gutsy Ninja - The Jiraiya Ninja Chronicles
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya’s journey to seek out a student is postponed due to the outbreak of the Third Great Ninja War. Jiraiya joins Tsunade and Orochimaru to battle the Village Hidden in the Rain. Following the battle, the three ninja are named the “Legendary Sannin,” a title given to them by the enemy Hanzo of the Great Salamander himself.

episodes_data.title: Infiltrate! The Village Hidden in the Rain
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya successfully infiltrates the Hidden Rain Village by hiding inside the toad Gamagoro. He sets out to gather information but finds no indications of a civil war occurring within the village.

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Became God
episodes_data.description: Foreseeing a possible battle, Jiraiya takes precautionary measures by releasing the scroll toad that commands the key to Naruto’s Eight-Signed Seal.

episodes_data.title: Activate! Sage Mode
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya battles to defeat his former student Pain, who is now driven by his twisted ideals as an Akatsuki member.

episodes_data.title: Meeting the Six Paths of Pain
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya completes his Sage Mode transformation to battle the three Pains.

episodes_data.title: The Tale of the Gallant Jiraiya
episodes_data.description: Having lost his arm, Jiraiya is outmatched by the six Pains now appearing before him. Of the six, the one called Tendo is revealed to be Jiraiya’s former student Yahiko. Jiraiya is still puzzled by the Rinnegan’s true powers, but before he can gather his thoughts, he is forced back into battle.

episodes_data.title: Invitation to the Party
episodes_data.description: Sasuke arrives at one of the Akatsuki hideouts, having followed in Itachi’s footsteps. When Sasuke is about to enter the hideout alone, his older brother Itachi finally appears before him…

episodes_data.title: The Longest Moment
episodes_data.description: While Itachi waits for Sasuke in the Uchiha hideout, he recalls the past incident that led to his defection from the Leaf Village. When Sasuke arrives, the fated battle begins between the two brothers.

episodes_data.title: The Light & Dark of the Mangekyo Sharingan
episodes_data.description: Following their fierce genjutsu battle with the Sharingan, Itachi explains the secret behind the most powerful ocular jutsu, the Mangekyo Sharingan, and the history of the Uchiha clan…

episodes_data.title: Amaterasu
episodes_data.description: Sasuke loses his left eye to Itachi, but it turns out to be a genjutsu created by the Mangekyo Sharingan. Breaking free of the Tsukuyomi by force, Sasuke makes a furious comeback against the injured Itachi.

episodes_data.title: The End
episodes_data.description: At the climax of the battle, both Itachi and Sasuke run out of chakra. However, Sasuke reveals that his actions up until now were only a preparation for his final jutsu.

episodes_data.title: The Mystery of Tobi
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his comrades find themselves held up by Tobi, whose strange jutsu is more than just a simple genjutsu.

episodes_data.title: Fate
episodes_data.description: In the Akatsuki hideout Sasuke comes face to face with Madara. Announcing himself as Itachi’s accomplice from that fateful night, Madara goes on to tell Sasuke the truth about Itachi that he could never have known.

episodes_data.title: Truth
episodes_data.description: The Uchiha clan was plotting a coup d’etat. The story as told by Madara leaves Sasuke at a loss for words. Because of his gifted talent, Itachi was forced to suffer, torn between his loyalties to the Leaf Village and the Uchiha clan.

episodes_data.title: The Battle at Thunder Cloud Gorge
episodes_data.description: Flame from the Amaterasu still remains on the battlefield as Naruto and his teammates continue to search for Sasuke. But despite the search team’s best efforts, they cannot find any trace of him.

episodes_data.title: Eight-Tails vs. Sasuke
episodes_data.description: The Taka split up with the Akatsuki to hunt down the remaining Tailed Beast. At the Land of Lightning they go up against Killer Bee, whose attack utilizing Lightning Style and seven blades proves to be more than a match for them.

episodes_data.title: The Wanderer
episodes_data.description: The Leaf ninja fail to capture Itachi and also lose track of Sasuke. Calling off their pursuit, the team is heading back to the village when an urgent assignment from Lady Tsunade comes in. The mission stems from a treaty between the Third Hokage and the En no Gyoja of the Tsuchigumo Clan...

episodes_data.title: Successor of the Forbidden Jutsu
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his teammates are assigned to escort Hotaru, En no Gyoja’s granddaughter, to the Tsuchigumo Clan’s village located in the mountains. But Hotaru’s mind is still attached to Utakata, who left after Naruto’s arrival…

episodes_data.title: The Successor's Wish
episodes_data.description: Having arrived at the village, Hotaru parts with Naruto and his team. But the Magaki Troops are one step ahead and threaten Hotaru to hand over the forbidden jutsu. Utakata appears, and Shiranami recognizes him as a bounty listed in the Hidden Mist’s bingo book...

episodes_data.title: Rogue Ninja's Past
episodes_data.description: Yamato and Sai recognize their opponents as trackers from the Hidden Mist Village, but Naruto attacks without questioning. The Hidden Mist demands Utakata be handed over to them in exchange for Hotaru.

episodes_data.title: Heir to Darkness
episodes_data.description: Hotaru is brought back to the fort in Mount Katsuragi. Naruto, outraged to learn the forbidden jutsu was embedded inside Hotaru, demands an explanation from Tonbei. But it was none other than Hotaru herself who wished for this.

episodes_data.title: Separation
episodes_data.description: Believing Shiranami’s story, Hotaru writes a parting letter addressed to Utakata and leaves Mount Katsuragi. Meanwhile Naruto, still searching for Shiranami, falls into the Magaki Troops’ trap but manages to escape thanks to help from Utakata.

episodes_data.title: The Forbidden Jutsu Released
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Utakata successfully enter the Tsuchigumo village thanks to help from Sakura, Sai, and Yamato. Utakata senses the chakra filling the atmosphere and terrain behaving oddly, and together with Naruto, they enter the cave where the anomaly is originating.

episodes_data.title: Student and Teacher
episodes_data.description: Hotaru, under the control of Shiranami’s jutsu, uses the Forbidden Jutsu against Naruto and Utakata. Shiranami trembles with joy, having witnessed the power of the Forbidden Jutsu, while Hotaru is consumed by deep despair.

episodes_data.title: Somber News
episodes_data.description: Returning from the mission, Naruto recollects his strange encounter with Itachi. What did the now deceased Itachi wish to tell him? As Naruto ponders this, Kakashi makes an abrupt visit.

episodes_data.title: Following the Master's Shadow
episodes_data.description: Naruto wanders the streets of the Leaf Village, grief stricken over the death of Jiraiya. Unable to overcome his feeling of loss, Naruto traces back through his memories of Jiraiya. What can help the heartbroken Naruto get back on his feet?

episodes_data.title: Decryption
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his friends successfully decipher the code Jiraiya left behind with the help of some information Naruto has. The crew immediately calls Fukasaku over, but the message is not enough to solve the mystery of Pain.

episodes_data.title: The First Challenge
episodes_data.description: At Mount Myoboku, Naruto begins his Sage Jutsu training under Fukasaku. The first challenge is “Don’t move.” Fukasaku explains that an extensive amount of time is necessary in order to take in nature energy.

episodes_data.title: Surpassing the Master
episodes_data.description: Naruto continues his Sage training at Mount Myoboku, but with very slow progress. Fukasaku runs out of patience and suggests they move on to the next training…

episodes_data.title: Konoha Attack
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru and the others wait for the information Jiraiya brought back to be analyzed. The Hidden Leaf ninja continue their data analysis, when disaster strikes the village—

episodes_data.title: The Power to Believe
episodes_data.description: The Leaf Village is under heavy attack from Pain and Konan. Hearing the Akatsuki attack, Tsunade attempts to contact Fukasaku…

episodes_data.title: Pain vs. Kakashi
episodes_data.description: In one area of the village, Kakashi enters battle against Tendo Pain, but he can’t keep up with Tendo’s mysterious attacks. Shurado joins the fight, and Kakashi struggles with the two-on-one disadvantage.

episodes_data.title: The Mystery of Pain
episodes_data.description: The Leaf Village is under heavy attack from the Akatsuki. Underneath the village Danzo takes action to achieve his ambition. Meanwhile, searching through the Rain ninja’s mind, Inoichi Yamanaka is about to stumble upon valuable information.

episodes_data.title: Surname is Sarutobi, given name is Konohamaru
episodes_data.description: Konohamaru, Moegi, and Udon are shocked to see the disaster that has struck their home village. But to fulfill their duties as genin, each races out to direct the villagers to a safe location.

episodes_data.title: The World Shall Know Pain
episodes_data.description: Tsunade comes face to face with Tendo Pain on the rooftop of the Hokage mansion. When Pain demands the Nine Tails be handed over, Tsunade refuses. However, Pain uses the Ningendo’s power to learn of Naruto’s current location in Mount Myoboku. Tsunade clenches at the sight of the growing number of casualties within the Leaf. But Pain, who condemns the Leaf’s arrogance as a major nation, makes the choice to deliver catastrophic damage against the Leaf Village to teach them what true pain is.

episodes_data.title: Explode! Sage Mode
episodes_data.description: Sensing danger at hand, Naruto, along with Fukasaku, rushes back to the Leaf Village from Mount Myoboku. But what they see is the remains of the Leaf Village, leveled beyond recognition.

episodes_data.title: Pinch! Sage Mode Disappears
episodes_data.description: Naruto hits Pain with his Sage Jutsu-perfected Wind Style Rasen Shuriken. Although he succeeds in defeating Ningendo, the remaining Pain quickly confronts him.

episodes_data.title: Nine-Tails Captured
episodes_data.description: Gamabunta and the other toads are defeated while Naruto is captured by Pain. Naruto attempts to fight back with Sage Jutsu, but Gakido sucks out his chakra, forcing him to go out of Sage Mode.

episodes_data.title: Confession
episodes_data.description: Fukasaku and Shima fall in battle, leaving Naruto open to be captured by Tendo Pain. Just when all is thought to be lost, Hinata, who was following the battle with her Byakugan, steps in to face Pain.

episodes_data.title: Planetary Devastation
episodes_data.description: Naruto loses himself after seeing Hinata taken out right before his eyes. His anger  triggers the Nine Tails’ chakra to go out of control.

episodes_data.title: The Fourth Hokage
episodes_data.description: Naruto meets Minato Namikaze, the Fourth Hokage, inside his inner world. Before his death, Minato planted a fail-safe where he would appear within Naruto’s psyche should his son sprout eight tails.

episodes_data.title: The Two Disciples
episodes_data.description: To break the cycle of hate, Naruto heads to where the real Pain is hiding.

episodes_data.title: Big Adventure! Search for the Fourth Hokage's Legacy - Part 1
episodes_data.description: The story goes back to right before the start of the final rounds of the Chunin Exam. As Naruto trains in preparation for his upcoming match, he hears Jiraiya speak of “the Fourth Hokage’s legacy.”

episodes_data.title: Big Adventure! Search for the Fourth Hokage's Legacy - Part 2
episodes_data.description: Naruto and the others take on the oncoming challenges in order to find the secret technique and break the previous record set by the Fourth Hokage. But Naruto’s impulsive action leads the group into various troubles.

episodes_data.title: Meeting
episodes_data.description: Naruto comes face to face with Nagato and Konan. Naruto, wanting to confront the problem of their hate-filled ninja world, asks to hear Nagato’s side of the story before coming up with an answer.

episodes_data.title: The Birth of Pain
episodes_data.description: To fulfill their dream, Nagato, Yahiko, and Konan walk through the war zone in search of Jiraiya, hoping to learn ninjutsu from him. After completing their training, the three form an organization with Yahiko as its leader.

episodes_data.title: The Tale of Naruto Uzumaki
episodes_data.description: Naruto remains silent after learning of Nagato’s painful past. Nagato claims true peace cannot exist in this cursed world, dismissing Jiraiya’s ideal as nothing more than wishful thinking.

episodes_data.title: The Hero of the Leaf Village
episodes_data.description: Nagato, having decided to believe in Naruto’s word, performs his last forbidden jutsu: Gedo Art Rinne Rebirth.

episodes_data.title: Iruka the Novice Teacher
episodes_data.description: The Leaf Village is left in ruins in the wake of Pain’s assault on the village. While cleaning through the remains of Ninja Academy, Iruka finds an old pillar and recognizes it as a memoir from Naruto’s early years at the academy.

episodes_data.title: Iruka's Trials
episodes_data.description: Naruto spends his days competing with Sasuke, the academy’s star student, only to screw up and be the laughingstock of the class. Due to the childhood trauma of losing his parents to the Nine-Tailed Fox, Iruka finds it difficult to interact with Naruto as his student.

episodes_data.title: Iruka's Determination
episodes_data.description: Naruto takes up his classmates’ dare to venture into the forest and retrieve an item from the dead enemy ninja, unaware that the forest is still dangerous.

episodes_data.title: Jounin in Charge Kakashi Hatake
episodes_data.description: An emergency council is held before the Feudal Lord of the Land of Fire. The topic is to discuss plans to rebuild the Leaf Village, and Danzo strongly urges the council to select a new Hokage to replace Tsunade.

episodes_data.title: Inari's Tested Courage
episodes_data.description: The Leaf ninja work to rebuild the Hidden Leaf Village. While helping with the restoration, Naruto and Sakura are reunited with two old friends—the carpenter Tazuna and his grandson Inari from the Land of Waves.

episodes_data.title: Naruto, Revenge Lessons
episodes_data.description: Team 7 stops in a town for some rest, where they encounter a man named Tsukado who is out to avenge the death of his relative.

episodes_data.title: Gaara "Bonds"
episodes_data.description: Gaara, recalling a past mission carried out with the Leaf’s Team 7, points out that the Leaf Village has Naruto with them.

episodes_data.title: Naruto Outbreak
episodes_data.description: Naruto visits Sakura, who is caring for Tsunade. Sakura recalls an incident that took place three years before, in which she collapsed from symptoms that resembled a disease caused by a mysterious virus.

episodes_data.title: Set Out! Team Tenten
episodes_data.description: Tenten and Neji head for the Leaf Ninja Tool Research Lab to procure ninja tools necessary for rebuilding the Leaf Village.

episodes_data.title: Animal District
episodes_data.description: Condor, the ostrich previously captured by Team 7, now lives in a forest with baby ostriches. Since his last escape, Condor has trained himself to become a ninja ostrich.

episodes_data.title: Ah, Medicinal Pill of Youth
episodes_data.description: After accidentally finishing off Lee’s last special youth drink, Naruto asks Guy to make more, only to learn one of its key ingredients, the Jofuku Flower, is out of stock. Naruto is determined to get the Jofuku Flower for Lee’s sake.

episodes_data.title: Gutsy Master and Student - The Training
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya takes Naruto to a village in the hopes of teaching him how to counter the Sharingan’s genjutsu attack.

episodes_data.title: Record of the Ninja Gutsy Master and Student
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Jiraiya attempt to save a village from Kandachi, a former right-hand man to Hanzo of the Hidden Rain.

episodes_data.title: Sasuke's Paw Encyclopedia
episodes_data.description: Granny Cat requests that Sasuke and Team 7 collect the last cat paw print necessary to complete the “Paw Encyclopedia.”

episodes_data.title: Naruto and the Old Soldier
episodes_data.description: Naruto is assigned to a team led by jonin Hayama to patrol the north border of the Leaf Village. One of his teammates is Kosuke, an old man who has been a genin for over fifty years, earning him the title “Eternal Genin.”

episodes_data.title: Kakashi Love Song
episodes_data.description: A beautiful kunoichi spy named Hanare is captured for attempting to gather intel on the Hidden Leaf.

episodes_data.title: Neji Chronicles
episodes_data.description: During the Chunin Exam, Neji rests in the medical room, having lost to Naruto. Just as Tenten comes in to check up on him, they see the Leaf Village attacked by Orochimaru and his men.

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Died Twice
episodes_data.description: On his way home Naruto comes across a rock pasted with a peculiar talisman, which he tears off without thinking. That night, Naruto is surprised to find an amnesic ghost standing near his bed.

episodes_data.title: The Worst Three-Legged Race
episodes_data.description: Team 7 is after a group of thieves who have stolen the precious Golden Statue from the Feudal Lord`s sister.

episodes_data.title: Cooperation, Team 10
episodes_data.description: Team 7 and Team 10 are assigned to help a village that is troubled by bandits.

episodes_data.title: Rush Into the Darkness
episodes_data.description: Sasuke’s jealousy of Naruto’s tremendous growth in strength causes friction between the two. Tsunade decides to give them some time apart by assigning them separate missions.

episodes_data.title: The Sixth Hokage Danzo
episodes_data.description: Team Samui of the Hidden Cloud arrive at the Leaf Village and are shocked to find it in ruins. Nonetheless, they carry out their orders to deliver the Raikage’s official letter to the Hokage, when Danzo appears and announces that he is the new Hokage.

episodes_data.title: Five Kage Summit's Eve
episodes_data.description: Karui and Omoi of the Hidden Cloud press Naruto to give information regarding Sasuke. Naruto realizes they’re motivated by wanting to save their captured master, but decides he cannot sell out his friend. Instead, Naruto offers himself as a punching bag for Karui and Omoi to abuse to their hearts’ content.

episodes_data.title: Enter the Five Kage
episodes_data.description: Kage from each nation set out to attend the Five Kage Summit.

episodes_data.title: Naruto's Appeal
episodes_data.description: To prevent the cycle of hatred bound to occur should Sasuke be killed, Naruto goes to the Raikage and begs him to forgive Sasuke, but the Raikage quickly dismisses the request.

episodes_data.title: A Bitter Decision
episodes_data.description: Mifune calls for the formation of the Allied Shinobi Forces to counter the Akatsuki and proposes the Hokage to lead them. Meanwhile, Sai reveals Naruto’s actions to Sakura.

episodes_data.title: Racing Lightning
episodes_data.description: Madara, who has taken an interest in Naruto, makes a sudden appearance before Naruto and reveals the truth behind Itachi’s actions.  Meanwhile, the samurai learn of Sasuke and his team Taka’s entry into the Land of Iron, and battle ensues between the two groups.

episodes_data.title: Sasuke's Ninja Way
episodes_data.description: The truth behind Itachi’s actions leaves Naruto, Kakashi, and Yamato in shock. Madara then goes on to reveal the eternal hate stemming from as far back as the rivalry between the two sons of the legendary Sage of the Sixth Paths and its relation to the Uchiha clan.

episodes_data.title: The Five Kage's Power
episodes_data.description: Having blocked the combined attacks of Gaara, Temari, Kankuro, and Darui with his Susano’o, Sasuke goes after Danzo.

episodes_data.title: Declaration of War
episodes_data.description: The four Kage are startled by the sudden appearance of Madara Uchiha. Having sent Sasuke away to safety using the Transportation Technique, Madara unveils to the Kage his “Project Tsuki no Me.”

episodes_data.title: Sakura's Feelings
episodes_data.description: The Kage respond to Madara’s declaration of war by forming the Allied Shinobi Forces, with the Raikage as their leader.

episodes_data.title: A Tailed Beast vs. A Tailed Beast With no Tail
episodes_data.description: Killer Bee engages in a deadly battle against Kisame, who has come to capture the Eight-Tails.

episodes_data.title: As a Friend
episodes_data.description: Naruto learns from Sai that Sakura intends to kill Sasuke with her own hands. The Sand arrives to brief the Leaf ninja about what happened at the Five Kage Summit.

episodes_data.title: Danzo's Right Arm
episodes_data.description: Kakashi decides to go after Sakura to stop her, while Yamato and Naruto are ordered to return to the Leaf Village. Meanwhile, Sasuke confronts Danzo after seeing the many Sharingan embedded in his enemy’s right arm.

episodes_data.title: The Forbidden Ocular Jutsu
episodes_data.description: Danzo’s uncanny jutsu prevents Sasuke from landing a clean hit on his enemy. As Karin attempts to analyze Danzo’s jutsu, Madara recognizes it as Izanagi.

episodes_data.title: Shimura Danzou
episodes_data.description: Danzo believes he’s won the battle against Sasuke. Little does he realize, Sasuke placed him under genjutsu before they last exchanged blows.

episodes_data.title: Sakura's Resolve
episodes_data.description: Having tracked down Sasuke’s whereabouts with Kiba’s nose, Sakura attempts to put her allies to sleep and carry out the task of killing Sasuke herself.

episodes_data.title: Lost Bonds
episodes_data.description: Memories from his childhood course through Naruto’s mind as he rests to recover from his hyperventilation.

episodes_data.title: The Burden I Should Bear
episodes_data.description: Sakura tells Sasuke that she wishes to desert the village and join him. A skeptical Sasuke tells Sakura he will believe her if she can finish off Karin.

episodes_data.title: The Fated Two
episodes_data.description: Naruto reproaches Sasuke for attempting to kill Sakura. Then Sasuke reveals that he killed Danzo with his own hands. He goes on to declare his intent to purify the Uchiha clan’s name by annihilating the Hidden Leaf.

episodes_data.title: Top-Class Shinobi
episodes_data.description: Years ago at the Final Valley, Sasuke told Naruto about high-level shinobi being able to understand one another just by trading blows. Having become a high-level shinobi, Naruto is now able to understand Sasuke’s heart.

episodes_data.title: Infiltrator
episodes_data.description: Killer Bee returns to the Hidden Cloud Village to the delight of Omoi and Karui. He has brought Kisame’s sword, Samehada, with him. Bee believes the sword has taken a liking to him but is unaware that this is all just part of the Akatsuki’s plan.

episodes_data.title: Nations on the Move
episodes_data.description: The formation of the Allied Shinobi Forces is ratified by the Feudal Lords of the Five Great Nations. Each Kage returns to their village to prepare for the coming war

episodes_data.title: The Hokage Kakashi Hatake
episodes_data.description: Naruto gathers his friends and tells them that he will defeat Sasuke alone. Meanwhile, the Elders of the Leaf officially nominate Kakashi to become the next Hokage.

episodes_data.title: The Great Toad's Prediction
episodes_data.description: In Mount Myoboku, Gerotora, Fukasaku, and the Great Lord Elder are debating whether to give Naruto the key to the Tetragram Seal left behind by Jiraiya, an act that could unleash the Nine Tails.

episodes_data.title: Storage
episodes_data.description: At Mount Myoboku, Naruto prepares to store Gerotora within himself, but hesitates as it also holds the potential risk of unleashing the Nine Tails on the world.

episodes_data.title: The Five Kage's Decision
episodes_data.description: The denizens of the Leaf Village ready themselves for the coming of the Fourth Great Ninja War.

episodes_data.title: The Young Man and the Ocean
episodes_data.description: Tsunade sends out Naruto under the guise of a top-secret mission to keep him hidden away from the Akatsuki. Unfortunately, Naruto, Yamato, Gai, and Aoba are stuck at the pier due to a report of a monster attacking ships.

episodes_data.title: The Ninja of Benisu
episodes_data.description: During their voyage, Naruto, Yamato, Gai, and Aoba stop at an island to recover from severe seasickness. There, they unexpectedly meet up with Sakura, Ino, and Choji, who are on an assignment to gather medical herbs for Tsunade.

episodes_data.title: The Cursed Ghost Ship
episodes_data.description: Naruto`s ship is stranded at sea due to heavy fog, when another ship suddenly appears.

episodes_data.title: Battleship Island
episodes_data.description: Pirates living on an island resembling a battleship open fire on Naruto’s ship.

episodes_data.title: Island of Oblivion
episodes_data.description: Going after Guy, who was whisked away by a giant bird, Naruto, Yamato, and Aoba arrive on an island where they spot a young woman.

episodes_data.title: Fight, Rock Lee
episodes_data.description: Guy recalls the time when he and Lee celebrated Lee learning the Hidden Lotus technique.

episodes_data.title: Eat or Die! Mushrooms from Hell!
episodes_data.description: Making a stop at a nearby port to stock up on supplies, Naruto buys a rare mushroom from a vegetable merchant. But soon after they set sail for their next destination, Naruto and the other crewmembers find their ship infested with poisonous mushrooms.

episodes_data.title: Counterattack From the Shadows
episodes_data.description: Naruto’s Shadow Clones turn against their master after feeling mistreated and overworked.

episodes_data.title: The Closed Sea Route
episodes_data.description: As he prepares for the coming war, Shikamaru begins to feel the pressure of shouldering the lives of his friends. To help ease his mind, Shikaku sends his son on a mission to Mokuzu Island where Shikamaru meets up with Naruto.

episodes_data.title: The Girls' Get-Together
episodes_data.description: Hinata’s father Hiashi summons the Hyuga clan to discuss the role they will be playing in the upcoming Fourth Great Ninja War.

episodes_data.title: Naruto's Imposter
episodes_data.description: Naruto and the others encounter a thief who claims that he is Naruto Uzumaki of the Hidden Leaf. The real Naruto easily takes care of the imposter and hands him over to a ninja who was after the thief.

episodes_data.title: Naruto's Favorite Pupil
episodes_data.description: Konohamaru is eager to fight alongside his senior ninja in the coming war, but his young age prevents him from being assigned to the battlefield.

episodes_data.title: The Kunoichi of Nadeshiko Village
episodes_data.description: Naruto meets two kunoichi ninja named Shizuka and Tokiwa from the Nadeshiko village who are seeking the student of Jiraiya.

episodes_data.title: Friends You Can Count On
episodes_data.description: At the Ninja Academy, Shino recounts the time when he failed to capture a wanted thief.

episodes_data.title: Ah, My Longed-For Lady Tsunade
episodes_data.description: Tenten is helping out Lee’s training to enhance his Eight Inner Gates.

episodes_data.title: Sai's Rest
episodes_data.description: While taking a walk through the Leaf Village, Sai comes across some kids who remind him of Sakura and Naruto.

episodes_data.title: The Legendary Ino-Shika-Cho
episodes_data.description: Ino, Choji, and Shikamaru run into Kosuke, an elderly genin who they saved in a previous mission.

episodes_data.title: Kiba's Determination
episodes_data.description: Kiba trains hard to catch up to Naruto, who is now hailed as the hero of the Leaf Village, but with little success. Feeling desperate, Kiba asks Kakashi if he could train him.

episodes_data.title: Kakashi, My Eternal Rival
episodes_data.description: As the Leaf ninja’s ship heads toward their final stop for supplies before entering the Land of Lightning, Yamato warns the crew to stay alert for enemies who could mimic both the appearance and chakra of their closest allies.

episodes_data.title: Naruto's Oath
episodes_data.description: During his final stop for supplies on an island in the Land of Water, Naruto runs into Akatsuchi and Kurotsuchi of the Hidden Stone, who are on an assignment to deliver a letter from the Tsuchikage addressed to the Mizukage.

episodes_data.title: Land Ahoy! Is This the Island of Paradise?
episodes_data.description: After a long voyage at sea, Naruto’s ship finally arrives at the island of its destination. Before everyone can rejoice, a giant squid attacks the ship. Fortunately, the crew is saved by Killer Bee, the Eight Tails’ jinchuriki host.

episodes_data.title: Killer Bee and Motoi
episodes_data.description: Motoi warns Naruto that he is not yet ready to enter training to control the Tailed Beast. Undaunted, Naruto asks Motoi to tell him more about Killer Bee.

episodes_data.title: The Next Challenge! Naruto vs. Nine Tails!!
episodes_data.description: With Killer Bee as his new master, Naruto begins his training to control the power of a Tailed Beast. In order to do so, one must fight the Tailed Beast head on and absorb its chakra, converting it into one’s own power.

episodes_data.title: The Orange Spark
episodes_data.description: Inside his mind, Naruto continues his battle against Nine Tails to take control of its immense power.

episodes_data.title: Target: Nine Tails
episodes_data.description: Sixteen years ago, Fourth Hokage Minato Namikaze and his wife Kushina are expecting their first child, much to the delight of the young couple.

episodes_data.title: The Fourth Hokage's Death Match!
episodes_data.description: Minato is forced to use his Flying Raijin jutsu and leave his wife Kushina behind to save their newborn son, Naruto, from a masked assailant.

episodes_data.title: Thank You
episodes_data.description: Minato uses his Transportation Technique to move Nine Tails away from the Hidden Leaf Village.

episodes_data.title: Battle in Paradise! Odd Beast vs. The Monster!
episodes_data.description: Guy arrives at the Waterfall of Truth to help Naruto with his training. Instead he encounters Kisame, who has infiltrated the island to locate Naruto and Killer Bee.

episodes_data.title: The Man Named Kisame
episodes_data.description: Kisame’s escape is prevented thanks to Guy’s efforts. Aoba enters Kisame’s mind to gather intel on the Akatsuki.

episodes_data.title: The Angelic Herald of Death
episodes_data.description: Madara appears in the Hidden Rain Village seeking the corpse of Nagato and his Rinnegan.

episodes_data.title: The Bridge to Peace
episodes_data.description: Madara uses the forbidden jutsu Izanagi to escape Konan’s Paper Bomb trap.

episodes_data.title: The Super Secret S-Rank Mission
episodes_data.description: The Leaf and Cloud ninja prepare to relocate Naruto and Bee, as the Akatsuki may already have knowledge of their location. Aoba assigns Naruto an S-rank mission to distract him from learning about their true mission: keeping the two Jinchuriki hidden from the enemy.

episodes_data.title: The Artist Returns
episodes_data.description: Kabuto and a reanimated Deidara attempt to grab hold of the jinchuriki, but are stopped by the Tsuchikage, who has come to protect Naruto.

episodes_data.title: Assemble! Allied Shinobi Forces!
episodes_data.description: The Tsuchikage and his team manage to safeguard the Jinchuriki, but at the cost of losing Yamato to the enemy.

episodes_data.title: Meeting
episodes_data.description: A look back into the early years when Naruto and Sasuke first met and got to know each other.

episodes_data.title: Rivals
episodes_data.description: During the Chunin Exam, Sasuke witnesses Naruto’s growth as a shinobi.

episodes_data.title: Rift
episodes_data.description: Sasuke’s defeat to Gaara, and later Itachi, forces him to realize that he is not strong enough to get revenge against his older brother.

episodes_data.title: Parting
episodes_data.description: Naruto is determined to save Sasuke, who has deserted the Hidden Leaf.

episodes_data.title: For My Friend
episodes_data.description: The Allied Shinobi Forces are on standby, ready to confront Madara’s army of reanimated shinobi and 100,000 White Zetsu. But distrust still exists among the Allied Shinobi Forces, who were once sworn enemies until recently.

episodes_data.title: War Begins!
episodes_data.description: Kankuro’s commando unit enters enemy territory to set up a stronghold for the Allied Shinobi Forces. They are immediately ambushed by the Akatsuki’s own commando unit comprised of the reanimated Deidara and Sasori.

episodes_data.title: Sai and Shin
episodes_data.description: The Allied Shinobi Forces’ commando unit engages with the Akatsuki in the first wave of battle.

episodes_data.title: Secrets of the Reanimation Jutsu
episodes_data.description: Under the guidance of Killer Bee, Naruto enters the final stage of training to master the Tailed Beast Bomb, a Jinchuriki’s most powerful technique.

episodes_data.title: An Old Nemesis Returns
episodes_data.description: The commando unit is in hot water as they engage the reanimated Kekkei Genkai shinobi, which include Zabuza Momochi and Haku. Luckily, Kakashi and his unit arrive in time to assist them.

episodes_data.title: The First and Last Opponent
episodes_data.description: Kakashi and his unit devise a strategy to take on the Kekkei Genkai shinobi, but it’s foiled by Kabuto, who uses the Reanimation Jutsu to summon the most powerful members of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist.

episodes_data.title: The Brilliant Military Advisor of the Hidden Leaf
episodes_data.description: The Akatsuki dispatch an army of powerful reanimated shinobi and White Zetsu across the war zone, causing chaos within the Allied Shinobi Forces’ chain of command.

episodes_data.title: Battleground!
episodes_data.description: As Darui and his First Company engage an army of White Zetsu, the remaining forces must deal with reanimated shinobi.

episodes_data.title: Forbidden Words
episodes_data.description: Atsui, Samui, and Darui face off against Kinkaku and Ginkaku, the legendary brothers from the Hidden Cloud, feared even by the Raikage.

episodes_data.title: Golden Bonds
episodes_data.description: Darui manages to seal away Ginkaku. Fueled by the rage of losing his brother, Kinkaku transforms into a monster that resembles a jinchuriki’s Tailed Beast State.

episodes_data.title: Road to Sakura
episodes_data.description: Ino sees Sakura falling from the sky. Although she manages to save her, the shock of the fall has left Sakura with amnesia.

episodes_data.title: Mifune vs. Hanzo
episodes_data.description: Kankuro’s Commando Unit is cornered by Hanzo’s poison attack. Fortunately, Mifune and his Fifth Company arrive in time to provide assistance.

episodes_data.title: True Kindness
episodes_data.description: The Ino-Shika-Cho trio is ordered by Shikaku to take down the reanimated Asuma. Remembering Asuma’s final words, Shikamaru and Ino are determined to stop their former teacher.

episodes_data.title: The Complete Ino-Shika-Cho Formation!
episodes_data.description: Choji is unable to attack Asuma and loses his will to fight. Ino and Shikamaru try to snap Choji out of his paralysis.

episodes_data.title: A Message from the Heart
episodes_data.description: While training in Chakra Mode, Naruto senses the presence of the Nine Tails’ chakra seeping from Kinkaku outside.

episodes_data.title: Attack of the Gedo Statue
episodes_data.description: The Allied Shinobi Forces are on the verge of winning the war when Madara Uchiha appears. Madara summons the giant Gedo Statue and unleashes its devastating power.

episodes_data.title: Unison Sign
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Killer Bee rush to the battlefield when Nine Tails suddenly speaks to Naruto inside his mind.

episodes_data.title: Medic Ninja in Danger
episodes_data.description: Over at the Medical Unit camp, Sakura and the other medic ninja work nonstop to treat the wounded. Neji is there to recover from overusing his Byakugan.

episodes_data.title: White Zetsu's Trap
episodes_data.description: Kiba, Shino, and Hinata are sent to investigate an area where the Akatsuki are supposedly getting through. There, the three are ambushed by a White Zetsu and get separated.

episodes_data.title: Aesthetics of an Artist
episodes_data.description: Back at the Fifth Company’s camp, Kurotsuchi attempts to negotiate with the captive Deidara to find out Kabuto’s location, but is quickly rebuffed.

episodes_data.title: The Allied Mom Force!
episodes_data.description: With many of the shinobi away serving in the Fourth Great Ninja War, the Leaf Village is left with just the mothers and children to protect it. Konohamaru is eager to guard the village but is quickly discouraged by the adults who tell him to just go about his day as usual.

episodes_data.title: The Secret Origin of the Ultimate Tag Team!
episodes_data.description: Tsunade and the Raikage arrive to prevent Naruto and Killer Bee from joining the battle. But the two Kage fail to convince the Jinchuriki to turn back, forcing the Raikage to use extreme force.

episodes_data.title: Two Suns!
episodes_data.description: Fourth Raikage Ay attacks Naruto in an attempt to prevent the Jinchuriki from falling into Madara’s hands.  Ay is unwilling to listen to either Tsunade or Killer Bee’s pleas to change his mind.

episodes_data.title: The Helmet Splitter: Jinin Akebino!
episodes_data.description: Kakashi assigns Sai to take over for the Sealing Corps, who are recovering from sealing the reanimated shinobi. But Sai is not sure if he can handle the responsibility. Soon afterwards, the Third Company is attacked by Jinin Akebino.

episodes_data.title: User of the Scorch Style: Pakura of the Sand!
episodes_data.description: A group of Allied Shinobi, including Omoi and Maki of the Sand, battle against several reanimated enemies. Maki recognizes one of them as Pakura, her former master who was a Sand Village hero.

episodes_data.title: Things You Can't Get Back
episodes_data.description: Still coping with the loss of her loved ones, Tsunade indulges in gambling and drinking. Around the same time, the Raikage Ay and his men are on a mission to steal a scroll from a certain village.

episodes_data.title: One Worth Betting On
episodes_data.description: The Raikage Ay and his team suffer critical injuries during an enemy attack. Unwilling to sacrifice any more of his men, Ay seeks medical help from Tsunade, who just happens to be in the area.

episodes_data.title: Danger: Jinpachi and Kushimaru!
episodes_data.description: Kakashi races to the scene where the Seven Ninja Swordsmen Kushimaru Kuriarare and Jinpachi Munashi were last sighted. Enraged by the carnage they’ve left behind, Kakashi teams up with Might Guy.

episodes_data.title: The Lightning Blade: Ameyuri Ringo!
episodes_data.description: Omoi’s unit is attacked by Ameyuri Ringo of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen and loses one of Omoi’s men. Omoi attempts to avenge his comrade, but Nurui orders everyone to retreat.

episodes_data.title: Power - Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his team are assigned a mission to identify and hunt down the perpetrator of the Tonika Village massacre. It’s been a while since Naruto has had a mission, and he’s pumped to take it on.

episodes_data.title: Power - Episode 2
episodes_data.description: While investigating the village near Tonika, Kabuto confronts Naruto. An epic battle erupts as Kabuto uses the forbidden Reanimation Jutsu against Naruto. In the meantime, Dokku and the five survivors lie low at the village.

episodes_data.title: Power - Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Sakura decide to stay at Shiseru’s house overnight to help watch over the survivors. Although the children cry and miss their deceased parents, Dokku and Shiseru try hard to bring everyone together as a new family.

episodes_data.title: Power - Episode 4
episodes_data.description: A clone possessing the Nine Tails’ chakra emerges from Naruto’s body. Seeking more power, the clone goes on a rampage, destroying everything in its path.

episodes_data.title: Power - Episode 5
episodes_data.description: After their defeat by the Nine Tails’ clone, Naruto and Dokku are taken captive by Kabuto.

episodes_data.title: Power: Final Episode
episodes_data.description: The legendary Ama no Hoko imbues the Nine Tails’ clone with enough power to destroy the world. Naruto is overcome by its immense power and lies unconscious.

episodes_data.title: Naruto Enters the Battle!
episodes_data.description: Naruto makes his entrance onto the battlefield and uses his sensory powers to detect and destroy the transformed White Zetsu clones. During the battle, Shikaku updates Naruto with what they currently know on Madara.

episodes_data.title: A Father's Hope, a Mother's Love
episodes_data.description: Gaara leads the Fourth Company into battle against the previous Kage, including his father, the late Fourth Kazekage. The Fourth Kazekage attacks Gaara in order to determine if his son is truly worthy to be the current Kazekage.

episodes_data.title: Contact! Naruto vs. Itachi
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Killer Bee engage in battle against the reanimated Itachi Uchiha and Nagato. Itachi learns from Naruto that Sasuke has chosen the path of vengeance.

episodes_data.title: The Ones Who Are Acknowledged
episodes_data.description: Itachi uses the ultimate genjutsu technique Koto Amatsukami to free himself from the Reanimation Jutsu. Itachi then joins Naruto and Killer Bee to fight Nagato, who is still under Kabuto’s control.

episodes_data.title: The Mizukage, the Giant Clam and the Mirage
episodes_data.description: The Fourth Company continue their fight against the reanimated Kage. Gaara and Ohnoki team up to hold off Second Tsuchikage Mu, while the remaining shinobi take on the Second Mizukage, who is willing to be sealed away.

episodes_data.title: Paradox
episodes_data.description: Temari leads the attack on the Third Raikage using Wind Style, but even her strongest jutsu is not enough to penetrate the Raikage’s invincible armor.

episodes_data.title: Terror: The Steam Imp
episodes_data.description: Gaara and Ohnoki manage to overcome the Second Mizukage’s mirage attack. Having taken an interest in Gaara, the Second Mizukage decides to further test the young Kage’s skills.

episodes_data.title: Ghosts from the Past
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru, Choji, Neji, and Kiba find themselves up against some familiar faces from the past. The Sound Ninja Four have been brought back by Kabuto’s Reanimation Jutsu, and they are ready to seek vengeance.

episodes_data.title: The Underworld Transfer Jutsu
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru, Neji, Choji, and Kiba succeed in defeating the Sound Ninja Four. But the enemy uses the Underworld Transfer Jutsu to trap the Leaf shinobi’s souls inside a barrier.

episodes_data.title: The Vengeful
episodes_data.description: Time is running out for the Leaf shinobi whose souls are trapped inside the Sound Four’s barrier. Ino and Shino exhaust their own chakra to keep their friends alive.

episodes_data.title: The Heart's Eye
episodes_data.description: Hinata defends Neji from a White Zetsu clone while he’s recovering from an earlier fight. She then remembers the time Neji protected her the same way after she temporarily lost her sight.

episodes_data.title: Fade Into the Moonlight
episodes_data.description: Three years ago, Leaf Anbu Yugao Uzuki lost her lover Hayate Gekko in battle. Unable to cope with his death, Yugao has since left the Anbu and joined the Medical Corps. Meanwhile, Kabuto has reanimated Hayate.

episodes_data.title: Night of the Crescent Moon
episodes_data.description: Yugao is ordered by Sukui to track down the reanimated Hayate. Still shaken by her lover’s unexpected return as an enemy, Yugao manages to catch up to Hayate and his men.

episodes_data.title: The A-Rank Mission: Food Fight
episodes_data.description: Naruto arrives to help a team of Allied Shinobi Forces led by Karui, who are struggling against a reanimated samurai. Naruto recognizes the samurai as Tatewaki, a man he met during a past mission.

episodes_data.title: The Fallen Castle
episodes_data.description: The Leaf Shinobi succeed in bringing young lord Shu into custody, placing a disguised Naruto as his double. But Tatewaki soon uncovers Naruto’s identity and surrounds the intruder with his men.

episodes_data.title: Prologue of Road to Ninja
episodes_data.description: Madara is prepping his new jutsu Limited Tsukuyomi, choosing Naruto as his test subject. Meanwhile, Naruto is spending his day off alone in his room. Thinking that Naruto is lonely, Lee suggests they all go to the bathhouse .

episodes_data.title: The Old Master and the Dragon's Eye
episodes_data.description: Might Guy arrives on the battlefield to stop a Reanimated Shinobi who he recognizes as Master Chen, the legendary Taijutsu User from the Third Great Ninja War.

episodes_data.title: Rain Followed by Snow, With Some Lightning
episodes_data.description: A reanimated boy who can control weather appears before Team Ino-Shika-Cho, Sakura, and Kiba, who are all fighting in different locations. To their surprise, the boy seems to know them.

episodes_data.title: The Sad Sun Shower
episodes_data.description: The weather-controlling enemy is revealed to be Yota, a boy who came to the Leaf Village years ago and befriended the local kids, including Naruto.

episodes_data.title: Lingering Snow
